verdict.rationale: Mastra documents cron-scheduled workflows ("declare a `schedule` field... Mastra will fire it on the cron you specify") and cron-scheduled agents. It also documents background tasks that dispatch long-running tool calls without blocking, durable goals the agent keeps pursuing across iterations, and persisted suspend/resume state for long-running runs, with observability over every run. Together these cover autonomous background automation. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that scheduled and background automations work reliably in practice, since all evidence is vendor docs.
